description: This file defines a Next.js page component that displays a list of recipes, with search functionality to filter recipes based on user input. It imports external components and data, and renders dynamic content based on search parameters.

methods.name: filterRecipes
methods.description: Filters the list of recipes based on a search query, matching against recipe titles and tags.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main page component that retrieves search parameters, filters recipes, and renders the recipe list or a message if no matches are found.
